decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's core thermoforming material know-how, so it can interpret lab feedback and keep improving them at low cost.
PETG thermoforming blanks sit squarely within established in-house thermoforming competence and serve as a staple consumable for dental labs.
The UV-curing lacquer relates to the firm's light-curing expertise, but its marginal web presence and niche role make consolidation into the broader range a moderate risk.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's digital scanning and manufacturing strategy, though it lies somewhat outside its core materials base and faces commodity competition.
Custom earmolds are a core hearing-care competence backed by skilled custom manufacturing and digital production, which lets the firm absorb market feedback effectively.
Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold know-how and digital workflows in an adjacent market the firm understands well.
